name: Hive 1.3.1
notes: Multiplayer polish. Windows: agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) no longer flash a console window when they run. Members pane simplified to one correct way to add people — invite by GitHub handle (it seals the workspace key and registers membership); the confusing manual placeholder 'Add member' is gone. When two teammates both have a default agent named 'hive', replies now show whose hive answered (the responder's name + avatar). And you're now notified if an owner/admin removes you from a workspace, instead of silently losing access.
